task_list.name: nnUnet Segmentation
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Run 3D nnUnet V2 semantic segmentation on channel images given a user-trained model.

### Outputs
- Semantic segmentation label image and corresponding ROI table.

### Limitations
- Currently only supports 3D segmentation, not 2D.
- Follows Cellpose task structure and dependent on fractal tasks core masking.

UnetChannelInputModel.description: Channel input for cellpose with normalization options.
UnetChannelInputModel.title: UnetChannelInputModel

zarr_url.title: Zarr Url
zarr_url.description: Path or url to the individual OME-Zarr image to be processed. (standard argument for Fractal tasks, managed by Fractal server).

level.title: Level
level.description: Pyramid level of the image to be segmented. Choose `0` to process at full resolution.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Channel for segmentation; requires either `wavelength_id` (e.g. `A01_C01`) or `label` (e.g. `DAPI`), but not both.

input_ROI_table.title: Input Roi Table
input_ROI_table.description: Name of the ROI table over which the task loops to apply nnUnet segmentation. Examples: `FOV_ROI_table` => loop over the field of views, `organoid_ROI_table` => loop over the organoid ROI table (generated by another task), `well_ROI_table` => process the whole well as one image.

output_ROI_table.title: Output Roi Table
output_ROI_table.description: If provided, a ROI table with that name is created, which will contain the bounding boxes of the newly segmented labels. ROI tables should have `ROI` in their name.

output_label_name.title: Output Label Name
output_label_name.description: Name of the output label image (e.g. `"organoids"`).

model_path.title: Model Path
model_path.description: Path to nnUnet model folder, e.g. ../nnUNetTrainer__nnUNetPlans__3d_fullres

folds.title: Folds
folds.description: List of folds (int) to use for cross-validation ensemble prediction. Available folds vary based on training settings. E.g. (0,) uses only fold 0 for prediction, whereas (0,1,2,3,4) uses folds 0-4 and averages their output. Default is (0,1,2,3,4)

log_transform_prior_to_prediction.title: Log Transform Prior To Prediction
log_transform_prior_to_prediction.description: Boolean, if True the input numpy array is log-transformed (natural log, e) before being passed to nnUnet for prediction.

use_masks.title: Use Masks
use_masks.description: If `True`, try to use masked loading and fall back to `use_masks=False` if the ROI table is not suitable. Masked loading is relevant when only a subset of the bounding box should actually be processed (e.g. running within `organoid_ROI_table`).

task_list.name: nnUnet Semantic to Instance Segmentation
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Convert semantic segmentation output of nnUnet to instance segmentation.
- Select which semantic class is converted to numerically increasing instance labels.
- Based on distance watershed and GASP algorithms similar to PlantSeg implementation.

### Outputs
- Instance segmentation label image (numerically increasing order starting from 1) and corresponding ROI table.

### Limitations
- Currently only supports 3D segmentation, not 2D.
- Follows Cellpose task structure and dependent on fractal tasks core masking.

zarr_url.title: Zarr Url
zarr_url.description: Path or url to the individual OME-Zarr image to be processed. (standard argument for Fractal tasks, managed by Fractal server).

level.title: Level
level.description: Pyramid level of the image to be segmented. Choose `0` to process at full resolution.

boundary_label_name.title: Boundary Label Name
boundary_label_name.description: Name of label for boundary segmentation (nnUnet output).

semantic_label_name.title: Semantic Label Name
semantic_label_name.description: Name of label for semantic class segmentation (nnUnet output), e.g. foreground/background or more.

masking_ROI_table.title: Masking Roi Table
masking_ROI_table.description: Name of the ROI table over which the task loops to apply nnUnet segmentation. E.g. `organoid_ROI_table` => loop over the organoid ROI table (generated by another task)

output_ROI_table.title: Output Roi Table
output_ROI_table.description: If provided, a ROI table with that name is created, which will contain the bounding boxes of the newly segmented labels. ROI tables should have `ROI` in their name.

output_label_name.title: Output Label Name
output_label_name.description: Name of the output label image (e.g. `"organoids"`).

select_semantic_class.title: Select Semantic Class
select_semantic_class.description: Integer label ID for class to select from semantic_label_name. Task will return instances of this class. For example, if semantic segmentation has 3 classes: background, lumen, epithelium - select which one should be instanced.

gaussian_sigma.title: Gaussian Sigma
gaussian_sigma.description: Standard deviation value for 3D Gaussian smoothing applied to object boundaries to generate probability map-like image. Sigma specified blur in X,Y ; Z dimension is scaled accordingly based on pixel spacing and accounts for voxel anisotropy.

watershed_threshold.title: Watershed Threshold
watershed_threshold.description: Threshold value (0 to 1) applied to the boundary probability map before computing the distance transform. Values below this threshold are considered background. Defaults to 0.05. From PlantSeg dt_watershed function. Higher values make probability map edges narrower.

watershed_sigma_seeds.title: Watershed Sigma Seeds
watershed_sigma_seeds.description: Standard deviation for Gaussian smoothing applied to the seed map (used for initializing the watershed regions). Higher values result in more smoothed seeds. Defaults to 1.0. From PlantSeg dt_watershed function. Higher values result in fewer seeds.

watershed_sigma_weights.title: Watershed Sigma Weights
watershed_sigma_weights.description: Standard deviation for Gaussian smoothing applied to the weight map. The weight map combines the distance transform and input map to guide the watershed. Larger values result in smoother weight maps. Defaults to 2.0. From PlantSeg dt_watershed function.

watershed_alpha.title: Watershed Alpha
watershed_alpha.description: Blending factor to combine the input boundary probability maps and the distance transform when constructing the weight map. A higher alpha prioritizes the input maps and reduces the contribution from the distance transform. Defaults to 1.0. From PlantSeg dt_watershed function.

watershed_min_size.title: Watershed Min Size
watershed_min_size.description: Minimum size of the segmented regions to retain. Regions smaller than this size are removed. Defaults to 100. From PlantSeg dt_watershed function.

gasp_beta.title: Gasp Beta
gasp_beta.description: Beta parameter for GASP. Small values steer towards under-segmentation, while high values bias towards over-segmentation. Default is 0.5. From PlantSeg gasp function.

combine_boundary_and_semantic_edges.title: Combine Boundary And Semantic Edges
combine_boundary_and_semantic_edges.description: if True, edges are detected in the semantic image for the selected semantic class to yield a binary boundary label. These edges are combined with the input boundary label, via binary union, and this combined edge image is used as input for watershed and gasp algorithm. Can lead to more stable results if semantic segmentation has more accurate predictions of object edges.
